title: Ontology of Intelligence
summary: Existing Transformer and large model theoretical frameworks uniformly adopt the “predictionfirst” paradigm, defining intelligence as fitting the data distribution of the real world and next-token prediction. This theory overturns the conventional view and proposes the sole origin of intelligence: continuous, multi-layered, global closed-loop mathematical verification. All artificial intelligence behaviors (fitting, reasoning, association, generation, generalization, error correction, cognition) are essentially mathematical comparison, constraint checking, differential stability…

review.subject: cs.AI
review.reason: Theoretical framework describing intelligence as continuous mathematical verification.
